generationPolicyMeaning.may-generate-new: A generator may create a NEW original asset for this role. It must not copy an existing file and must not present the result as fourmula.ai's own or as a third party's.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-reuse-exact: The asset is fourmula.ai's own brand asset or a vendored component asset. A generator may only reference the existing local file (or the existing inline SVG) by exact path. It must not recreate, redraw, re-trace, recolour, crop or 'improve' it.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-fabricate: The asset depicts real people, real third-party brands, or fourmula.ai's own real product and marketing imagery. A generator must NEVER create, redraw, approximate, restyle or AI-render it. Only an exact reference to a file that already exists under public/ is allowed. If the slot needs a different real asset, leave it an explicit placeholder for a human to supply with rights confirmed.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-redistribute: The asset is commercially licensed to a third party (Apple's SF Pro Display; GreenSock's paid SplitText plugin). It may be referenced where it already lives. It must never be regenerated, converted, subset, re-hosted or copied into a new package or into generated output.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-wire-up: The slot is a deliberately INERT interactive control. A generator must reproduce it as layout only and must never give it a destination, a handler, state, storage or a network call. Grounded in exactly one real slot: the /auth sign-in form.

policyNote: Exactly five policies, each grounded in a real asset class in this project: may-generate-new (generic glyphs), must-reuse-exact (brand marks and vendored component assets), must-not-fabricate (real people, real third-party logos, real product imagery), must-not-redistribute (Apple's SF Pro Display and GreenSock's paid SplitText) and must-not-wire-up (the inert /auth form).
pinnedPolicyMechanism: Every role with complianceCritical=true carries pinnedPolicy equal to its generationPolicy. extraction/verify_all.py check [j] asserts generationPolicy == pinnedPolicy for exactly those roles. Membership in the five-value enum is NOT sufficient: may-generate-new is a valid enum member that would be wrong for every pinned role. The check is proven by mutations to a DIFFERENT-BUT-VALID policy value in schema/tests/adversarial_test.py and extraction/prove_drift.py (MASTER-GUIDE 3.23).

globalRules.realCompany: fourmula.ai is a REAL, LIVE COMPANY. Nothing in this repository grants any right to its copy, brand marks, product imagery or the likeness of any person appearing in its assets. A generator must never reproduce, redraw, recolour, re-render, approximate or AI-regenerate fourmula.ai's real logo or wordmark, its real brand marks, its real product imagery, any real person's photograph or video, any real third-party company logo, or its real marketing copy.
globalRules.noExternalRequests: Every asset reference in this project is a LOCAL absolute path. grep -rhoE '(href|src)="https?://' src --include='*.jsx' returns ZERO matches. A generated PageSpec must never reference a remote URL, a protocol-relative // URL, or a path containing '..' - the schema's pattern and the semantic validator both reject all three.
globalRules.noOutboundLinks: Links in a PageSpec may only be '#' (inert), a '/#anchor' in-page anchor, or one of the six real routes. Formerly-external links became local routes (/start, /auth) or inert hashes on purpose; a generator must never reintroduce an outbound link. Enforced by the NO_EXTERNAL_LINKS graph rule and proven by an adversarial case.
globalRules.licensingReview: Do not publish or make this repository public without the owner's licence review.

roles.description: NOT AN IMAGE. The behaviour role of the sign-in form on /auth. The form is DELIBERATELY INERT: it has no action attribute, no handler beyond onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}, no React state, no network call, and nothing is read from or stored for the email field. It stands in for a real sign-in screen purely as layout.
roles.licensing: COMPLIANCE-RELEVANT. Generated output must keep this slot inert. It must not be given an action, a submit handler, a fetch/XHR call, an analytics event, a state binding, local or session storage, a cookie, or any third-party auth SDK. A credential field that looks real but goes somewhere undisclosed is a phishing surface; a credential field that goes somewhere real is a security surface the owner has not approved. Both are out of scope for a generated page.
roles.pinnedValueRationale: Membership in the five-value generationPolicy enum is NOT sufficient for this role: may-generate-new and must-reuse-exact are both valid enum members and both WRONG here. extraction/verify_all.py check [j] therefore compares generationPolicy against pinnedPolicy for this role specifically (MASTER-GUIDE 3.23), and the adversarial suite mutates it to a DIFFERENT-BUT-VALID value to prove the check catches it.
roles.schemaWiring: sections/content-tech.json binds this role to the auth-form variant's `form.assetRole` slot with enum ["auth-inert-form"], so a PageSpec cannot put any other role there.
